Name: Gorillaz Albums - Furniture Pack
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[b][size=4]Content[/size][/b]
Decorate your house with wall decor featuring pixel art renditions of all main studio albums by Gorillaz, totalling nine to choose from.

There are two versions of this mod available to download with the same content available in each; please pick one that works best for you.
[list]
[*]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] version adds the albums as new, completely separate furniture. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36168]Vinilla's Album Catalogue[/url] installed, they will appear there; otherwise they'll show up in the regular Furniture Catalogue.[/*]
[*]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version allows you to change the appearance of any 32x32 vanilla painting with the paint bucket tool into an album of your choosing. The AT version has no interaction with Vinilla's Album Catalogue.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Installation and Removal[/size][/b]
Can be installed and uninstalled like any other mod, by unzipping into your Mods folder. If using the AT version, albums will revert to their "true appearance" after uninstalling. CP version albums will turn into error items which can be thrown away.

[size=4][b]More Mods[/b][/size]
Check out other mods in my album furniture series:
[list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25592]Sparks Albums[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36168]Vinilla's Album Catalogue[/url][/*]
[/list]Check out my [url=https://vinillavin.neocities.org/]neocities[/url] if you enjoyed my mod! Thanks for checking it out :D
